response.sql: WITH c AS (SELECT observstation, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM telescopes GROUP BY observstation), s AS (SELECT observstation, cnt, CAST(cnt AS REAL) / SUM(cnt) OVER () AS share FROM c), a AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM s) SELECT AVG(s.cnt) AS avg_telescope_count, AVG(s.share) AS avg_share, AVG(s.share - a.avg_share) AS avg_excess_over_avg_share FROM s CROSS JOIN a WHERE s.share > a.avg_share

assumptions.assumption: The set of observatories is those appearing in the telescopes table (observatories with no telescopes are not included), as the request specifies observstation in the telescopes table. The average share across all observatories is therefore 1 divided by the number of such observatories.
